sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Player_Attributes"."preferred_foot" AS g, AVG("Player_Attributes"."sliding_tackle") AS m1, AVG(("Player_Attributes"."vision" - "Player_Attributes"."volleys")) AS m2 FROM "Player_Attributes"  GROUP BY "Player_Attributes"."preferred_foot"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3"
quantities: Player_Attributes.vision rating minus volleys skill rating
why: average of sliding tackle rating per Player_Attributes.preferred_foot
vision rating - volleys skill rating: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same player attribute snapshot on a date
average of vision rating minus volleys skill rating per Player_Attributes.preferred_foot
gap to the all average of average of vision rating minus volleys skill rating (all level)
